verdict.rationale: Feitian documents Azure AD/Entra ID integration, including passwordless sign-in to Azure AD-joined Windows 10 and Microsoft 365 accounts. It also covers Google Advanced Protection and general W3C WebAuthn compatibility, so the keys should work with standards-based IdPs. However, the evidence never mentions Okta or Google Workspace admin enrollment, and nothing covers enforcing hardware-key-only policies or fleet-level attestation. Missing for 10: Okta integration evidence, Google Workspace (admin) integration evidence, policy enforcement or attestation guidance for admins, independent corroboration.
